messages:
Marta (CS): FYI AuroraX just uploaded a vendor security spreadsheet — ~40 Qs, several SOC2 / key-management asks. They flagged this as blocking renewal unless answered in 3 biz days.
Ravi (AE): Ugh, timeline tight. Are these new asks vs last year? Any specific redlines?
Marta (CS): Yes — two new asks: want KMS vendor certs + confirmation of EU data residency for embeddings. Also Q12 asks about short-lived keys for customers.
Eli (Sec): Send me the form. Short-lived keys question probably refers to API key rotation + session tokens. We don't currently offer per-tenant short-lived tokens for hosted API.
Marta (CS): Uploaded the PDF here: https://redwood.internal/drive/aurorax_vendor_form.pdf
onboarding-bot: Document uploaded by Marta (CS): aurorax_vendor_form.pdf
Samira (Onboard): If this blocks renewal we should prioritize. Proposed split: Security answers (Eli), Legal handles DPA amendment (Grace), CS covers ops/process answers (me + Marta).
Grace (Legal): I'll review DPA amendment and the specific residency ask. If they want contractually guaranteed EU-only storage for embeddings we need to check Dedicated/Private options.
Ravi (AE): AuroraX currently on hosted plan. Renewal next Friday — if we can't meet EU residency they might ask for migration to Dedicated which has procurement implications.
Eli (Sec): Q12 response draft: "We rotate service-side API keys monthly; customers can rotate their keys via Console; session tokens are short-lived (TTL 1h). We do not currently offer ephemeral per-tenant session credentials." Need to confirm Console rotation UX wording.
Marta (CS): Can someone paste the exact wording for rotation in Console? I want to be precise.
Samira (Onboard): Console copy: "Rotate API keys" -> shows last rotated timestamp + Generate new key button. No ephemeral tokens yet. I can screenshot.
Grace (Legal): For EU residency ask — ask product which models/embeddings store artifacts in EU. Ravi, need to know if customer data was ever replicated outside region.
Ravi (AE): I'll check usage logs and ping infra. ETA 4 hours.
Eli (Sec): Also need to know if we're willing to provide SOC2 subservice clarification. We can provide SOC2 report and SOC2 scope doc. I can attach a redacted copy.
Marta (CS): Action items:
- Eli: Draft security answers for Q1-Q15 by EOD (1767779200).
- Grace: Draft DPA amendment options (EU-only clause vs migration path) by EOD.
- Ravi: Confirm replication/region history within 4h.
- Samira/Marta: Prep enablement call invite for AuroraX and internal SME review (tomorrow morning).
Ravi (AE): ack. Will also flag this as renewal risk >50% if we can't meet residency.
Marta (CS): If anyone needs more context, AuroraX contact is lucy@aurorax.com. Let's keep replies inline here. :thumbsup: 
Eli (Sec): I'll start drafting. Anyone have the SOC2 redacted link?
Grace (Legal): Here: https://redwood.internal/secure/soc2_redacted_2025.pdf
Samira (Onboard): Scheduling invite now for 09:30 PT tomorrow with AuroraX + Eli + Grace + Marta.
onboarding-bot: Calendar invite created: AuroraX-security-review — 09:30 PT — Organizer Samira (Onboard)
Marta (CS): Thanks team. Will update AuroraX after security + legal drafts. Keep any replies short so I can forward.
Ravi (AE): thanks
Eli (Sec): starting draft
Grace (Legal): on it
